changelog: The notch now reopens on the tab you closed it on. To always open on Home, turn off Settings, General, Behaviour, Open on the last tab.
New: drag the tabs in the open notch to put them in the order you like.
Uses less CPU while music plays with the notch closed.
From 7.3.5: Capture, free for everyone. Take a screenshot of the full screen or an area, or record your screen with system sound and microphone, from the notch.
From 7.3.5: Smart Morph for Pro (beta). The closed notch reshapes itself for music, the Focus timer, charging and battery, and finished downloads. Settings, Widgets, Smart Morph.
From 7.3.5: choose the order of the notch's tabs in Settings, Widgets, Tab order.
From 7.3.5: fixed settings and Notchy changes that could fail to save on some PCs, and the Pro price showing "??" in place of the currency sign.
From 7.3.5: AI agent alerts no longer take keyboard focus, and download sizes show for Opera, Vivaldi and Arc.
